text:
Ravi: hey all, first proper oncall shift for me and i'm blocked before i even ack a page. runbooks redirect to https://runbooks.redwood.ai/eng/oncall/pgp with a cert error (ERR_SSL_PROTOCOL_ERROR). also when i check PagerDuty schedule it shows my name overlapping with another engineer for the same slot. filed a ticket but wanted quick help.
Lina: welcome @Ravi :wave: — that SSL error usually happens when corp cert isn't installed on your laptop (we have a corp root). are you on a company laptop or personal? also weird about overlapping slots  @Omar can you peek at the schedule?
Ravi: using personal laptop while my corp mac is in shipping. tried chrome + brave, same cert error. PD schedule shows: Ravi (08:00-16:00) and also says "Ravi (shadow)" 12:00-16:00 on top of Sam. looks like a duplicate entry.
Omar: weird. for the cert: download and install the corp root from https://internal.redwood.ai/certs/corp-root.pem then restart browser. if on linux, run `sudo cp corp-root.pem /usr/local/share/ca-certificates/ && sudo update-ca-certificates`. for the PD overlap: i see an old shadow entry leftover from the onboarding invite (shadow entries are separate schedule overrides). i'll remove the shadow instance so it doesn't look conflicting.
ops-bot: Runbooks Service  Render job queued for /eng/oncall/pgp (job 774).
Ravi: installed the cert and the runbook loads! thanks Omar. still not comfortable with the escalation matrix though  the runbook page has a table of contacts but the PD incident template shows a different escalation (calls infra first). which one is authoritative?
Lina: canonical is the runbook (runbooks are the source of truth). PD templates sometimes have stale escalation presets. @Omar can you push a quick note to PD incident template owners to align with the runbook? also i'm happy to be your buddy during the first rotation. want to run a 25m sim tonight?
Omar: filed a quick ops task: "Align PD template escalation with /eng/oncall/pgp runbook" (task #983). also removed the duplicate shadow entry for Ravi  the schedule now shows Ravi only 08:00-16:00.
infra-bot: Identity  Shadow schedule entry for ravi@redwood.ai removed by Omar at 2026-04-12T15:42Z.
oncall-bot: PagerDuty  Ravi added to schedule "eng-oncall" effective 2026-04-13 08:00 UTC. Please confirm when you see your shifts.
Ravi: i see the schedule now and the runbook. thanks both. yes Lina i'd love a sim tonight. quick extra: my PD mobile push test didn't trigger either. PD web shows device registered but test push fails with timeout. any fallback recommendations?
Lina: enable SMS fallback in PD profile and add a backup number. we also have a phone-tree for critical sev1 alerts (contact page). i'll DM you the list. for the sim, we'll test push + SMS.
Omar: quick tip for the runbook  search for the section "escalation-contacts" and look for the labeled primary/secondary. if PD template still shows infra-first, treat PD template as non-authoritative until we finish the template update.
Ravi: noted. one last tiny snag: when i open the runbook there is a small code block that references `scripts/pgp_failover.sh` but that file link 404s in the repo. should we avoid running anything that's not present?
Lina: absolutely avoid running missing scripts. i'll sync with docs and infra to either restore the script or update the runbook to a correct path. good catch.
Ravi: all right thanks everyone  ready for the sim tonight. what time works for you?
Lina: i'll do 19:30 PT tonight, 25m. dropping calendar invite. we'll run through ack, triage, and escalation to infra and db. Omar will demonstrate how to check quota dashboards and cancel a maintenance window if needed.
Omar: i'll demo `kubectl -n metrics logs quota-checker` and show the quick PD CLI commands: `pd incident acknowledge <id>` and `pd maintenance cancel <id>`. also i'll watch the PD template change task.
Ravi: confirmed 19:30 PT  thanks for the warm onboarding and the quick fixes. excited to shadow and learn. :thumbsup:
